metadata.title: A Three-Layer Dependency-and-Logic Audit for Mathematical Proofs and AI-Generated Claims: The S/M/P × D/L Framework
metadata.description: We introduce a structured audit framework for mathematical proofs, conjectures, and AI-generated mathematical claims. The framework operates on three layers—Semantic, Mathematical, and Programming—and for each layer examines two complementary dimensions: internal Dependency relations and internal Logic-structure discipline. The resulting S/M/P × D/L matrix provides six elementary audit cells (S*D, S*L, M*D, M*L, P*D, P*L) plus cross-layer mapping checks. Version 8 extends the Citation Discipline (Authenticity Check + Support Check) to all 66 curated reports and adds five new high-risk audits from the OpenAI 700+ mathematical manuscript corpus: full BSD from low Selmer corank, quasi-Riemann hypothesis, rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties, Hilbert's tenth problem over ℚ, and isomorphism of free group factors. The attached SMPDL_v1.9_sample_reports_66files.zip contains 66 markdown reports used to compute the joint SHA-256 fingerprint 873f89d0668bedde2633ac1017adac2722584762860ec1a4b89c6f0a075ef4c6.
